interactions.name: primary input
interactions.trigger: Open the invitation or create the account
interactions.response: Dashlane starts identity and security setup
interactions.feedback: The retained account entry state makes the available next action visible.
interactions.cancellation: Closing or leaving before submission produces no completion claim.
interactions.failure: Unavailable identity, permission, or prerequisite keeps the user at entry.
interactions.recovery: Restore the prerequisite and repeat the same entry action.

interactions.name: focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Complete email verification and account authentication
interactions.feedback: The recording advances to identity verified and retains the selected context.
interactions.cancellation: Back returns to the preceding entry context when the product exposes it.
interactions.failure: An invalid, expired, or unavailable selection does not advance to the next recorded state.
interactions.recovery: Correct, resend, or reselect and submit again.

interactions.name: navigation
interactions.feedback: The navigation result is visible as vault secured.
interactions.cancellation: The prior state remains the safe return target; optional work may be skipped only when shown.
interactions.failure: A denied authorization or missing required value leaves the destination unavailable.
interactions.recovery: Return to the preserved requirement and satisfy it before continuing.

interactions.name: confirmation
interactions.trigger: Install and authorize the browser extension
interactions.response: Dashlane shows the connected extension state
interactions.feedback: The official recording shows the confirmed extension ready state.
interactions.cancellation: A cancel or back action before confirmation does not create the terminal result.
interactions.failure: Rejected confirmation or validation keeps the flow incomplete with the current requirement visible.
interactions.recovery: Correct the blocking value or repeat authorization, then confirm again.

interactions.name: cancellation and backtracking
interactions.trigger: Use Back, Cancel, Decline, or the product's explicit optional Skip route before the terminal action.
interactions.response: The flow returns to the preceding requirement or leaves optional work pending rather than fabricating success.
interactions.feedback: The current-step surface and absence of terminal evidence make the interruption visible.
interactions.cancellation: This interaction is the observed cancellation boundary.
interactions.failure: Closing an unsaved or verification-pending step can leave onboarding incomplete.
interactions.recovery: Re-enter from the documented entry point and resume the last retained requirement.

interactions.name: progress feedback
interactions.trigger: Import or add a login credential
interactions.response: Dashlane stores the item in the vault
interactions.feedback: Progress is observable as the distinct credential added state.
interactions.cancellation: Leaving during feedback does not count as completion.
interactions.failure: No success is claimed while the product still reports pending, building, verifying, uploading, or incomplete work.
interactions.recovery: Wait for durable feedback or use the product's retry route.

interactions.name: failure
interactions.trigger: Submit missing, invalid, expired, denied, or otherwise unacceptable required input at the current requirement.
interactions.response: The product remains short of the terminal state and exposes the requirement or failure feedback.
interactions.feedback: The current state is retained; values already accepted by the product are not described as completed again.
interactions.cancellation: The user can leave without a false success state.
interactions.failure: The first-success outcome is unavailable until the blocking requirement is resolved.
interactions.recovery: Correct the value, resend the challenge, reconnect the provider, or retry the operation as appropriate.

interactions.name: recovery and completion
interactions.trigger: Use or inspect the credential from the extension
interactions.response: The item is available for autofill, proving first setup success
interactions.feedback: The retained autofill ready state is the completion evidence.
interactions.cancellation: After durable completion, leaving does not erase the recorded result; before it, leaving remains incomplete.
interactions.failure: If the terminal action fails, the user must remain on the actionable prior state rather than a false success page.
interactions.recovery: Return to the last durable state, retry the terminal action, and require the same completion evidence.

failure_route: At identity verified or vault secured, invalid, expired, denied, or missing required input leaves the flow short of autofill ready; evidence: media/state-02-identity-verified.png, media/state-03-vault-secured.png, and https://support.dashlane.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001537079-Get-started.

Back, Cancel, Decline, or an explicit optional Skip interrupts setup without substituting a success state; evidence boundary: media/state-03-vault-secured.png through media/state-05-credential-added.png.
recovery_route: Return to the retained identity verified or vault secured requirement, correct or resend the blocking input, and resubmit; evidence: https://support.dashlane.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001537079-Get-started.
Continue through the same terminal action until autofill ready is visible in media/state-06-autofill-ready.png and the motion at 80.940s.
journey.completion_evidence: autofill ready retained at media/state-06-autofill-ready.png and media/official-recording.mp4#t=80.940; source https://support.dashlane.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001537079-Get-started

observations: Visual observation from media/state-01-account-entry.png and media/state-02-identity-verified.png: the current task is presented with persistent on-screen text rather than motion alone.
Visual observation from media/state-03-vault-secured.png and media/state-04-extension-ready.png: primary choices remain spatially associated with their current setup context.
The six local frames provide a nonanimated way to inspect the sequence without playing motion.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, state announcements, and error associations cannot be established from the retained official recording.
Keyboard-only focus order and focus restoration after each transition were not exposed by the recording.
Text scaling, zoom reflow, voice input, one-time-code autofill, and password-manager behavior remain unverified.
The recording does not expose a product-level reduced-motion preference; the extracted state sequence is the retained nonanimated equivalent.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
